title: Part10 Phase12 — Schema-Pack Migration (G4)
description: Migrate the TS schema-pack subsystem (Schema Cathedral v3, ~4929 lines core + 1166 lines deleted command layer, 32 CLI verbs) to Rust. Rust currently has zero schema-pack implementation — only the UNMIGRATED_TS_SCHEMA_PACK_VERBS anchor constant and the freed `schema` command name. This is a B-class migration: must build Rust first, then delete TS. Key consumers: operations.ts (4243 lines, 12+ dynamic imports), cycle/ (3 files), commands/ (4 files). TS deletion is gated on consumer migration status.

1.label: Part10 Phase12 — Schema-Pack 迁移 (G4)
1.notes: G4 resolution. TS schema-pack = 26 source files (~4929 lines) in src/core/schema-pack/ + ~20 test files. Command layer (schema.ts, 1166 lines) already deleted in Phase11. Rust has NO schema_pack module; PageType in engine.rs is just String. 32 verbs across 4 groups: Inspection(9) + Activation(3) + Authoring(15) + Discovery/repair(5). Migration must build Rust core first, wire CLI verbs, then delete TS (gated on operations.ts consumer status).

1-1.label: 数据模型基础 (manifest-v1 + loader + primitives + closure)

decisions.answer: 4 modules: manifest(12 tests)+primitives(6 tests)+closure(10 tests)+loader(9 tests)=37 total. DfsColor moved to module level for dfs_detect scope. Rc<Cell<bool>> for 'static callback in depth_cap test. serde_yaml replaces TS hand-rolled mini-YAML parser.

1-1.notes:
Port the schema-pack data model to Rust crates/zbrain-core/src/schema_pack/:
- manifest-v1.ts (295 lines) -> SchemaPackManifest struct with serde validation (page_types, link_types, frontmatter_links, takes_kinds, enrichable_types, filing_rules, phases, calibration_domains). Pack identity = name@version+sha8.
- primitives.ts (90 lines) -> PackPrimitive enum (entity|media|temporal|annotation|concept) + getPrimitiveDefaults.
- loader.ts (268 lines) -> YAML/JSON file sniffing + hand-written YAML mini-parser -> manifest validation.
- closure.ts (180 lines) -> AliasGraph BFS closure (depth cap 4, symmetric per declaration, cycle detection).
Key: PACK_PRIMITIVES closed enum, zod schema -> serde derive + custom validation. SCHEMA_PACK_API_VERSION constant.

1-2.label: Registry + resolution engine (7-tier chain + cache + extends BFS)

decisions.answer: 6 modules: registry(23 tests)+per_source(12)+pack_lock(12)+trust_gate(9)+load_active(4)=62 new tests. 99 total schema_pack tests. manifest.rs extends changed String→Option<String>. closure.rs added compute_alias_closure_hash (8 bytes/16 hex). load_by_path skipped in load_active_pack (ResolvePackOpts requires 'static, acceptable for initial port). Windows is_pid_alive defaults to true (conservative).

1-2.notes:
Port the pack loading/resolution engine:
- registry.ts (336 lines) -> 7-tier resolution chain (CLI opt -> env -> per-source DB -> brain DB -> config -> ~/.zbrain -> default zbrain-base). Stat-TTL cache (~1000ms, env override). Extends-chain BFS (warn at 4, hard cap 8). Cascade invalidation on mtime change.
- load-active.ts (197 lines) -> loadActivePack boundary helper (resolution chain + disk load + extends chain + process cache).
- best-effort.ts (59 lines) -> loadActivePackBestEffort (graceful fallback).
- op-trust-gate.ts (130 lines) -> validateSchemaPackTrustGate (remote/MCP callers cannot pass schema_pack opt).
- per-source.ts (102 lines) -> buildPerSourceBindings + buildSourceClosureCte (federated read per-source pack filtering).
- pack-lock.ts (298 lines) -> per-pack file lock (O_CREAT|O_EXCL + stale detection + TTL refresh).
Depends on 1-1 (manifest, closure).

1-3.label: Inspection verbs (9 read-only, tracer bullet end-to-end)
1-3.notes:
First end-to-end vertical slice: CLI verb -> Rust core -> DB. Port read-only inspection modules + wire 9 CLI verbs under `zbrain schema` subcommand tree:
- stats.ts (245 lines) -> runStatsCore (per-type page counts, untyped coverage, dead-prefix hints, multi-source federated read).
- lint-rules.ts (388 lines) -> ALL_LINT_RULES + runAllLintRules + runFilePlaneLintRules (pure functions, CLI/MCP/mutation shared).
- query-cache-invalidator.ts (50 lines) -> invalidateQueryCache.
CLI verbs: active, list, show, validate, graph, lint, stats, explain, usage.
Wire into crates/zbrain-cli/src/lib.rs: new `schema` clap subcommand enum (SchemaSubcommand) with 9 variants. Remove 9 entries from UNMIGRATED_TS_SCHEMA_PACK_VERBS.
Depends on 1-1, 1-2.

1-4.label: Activation + authoring verbs (3+15=18 mutating verbs)
1-4.notes:
Port mutation engine + wire 18 CLI verbs:
- mutate.ts (644 lines) -> withMutation 8-step skeleton (lock->read->modify->lint->atomic write->audit->invalidate cache). addTypeToPack, removeTypeFromPack, updateTypeOnPack, addAlias/removeAlias, addPrefix/removePrefix, addLinkType/removeLinkType, setExtractable, setExpertRouting. locateMutablePackFile, BUNDLED_PACK_NAMES.
- mutate-audit.ts (224 lines) -> logMutationSuccess/Failure, readRecentMutations, summarizeMutations, computeMutateAuditPath.
CLI verbs (activation): use, downgrade, reload.
CLI verbs (authoring): init, fork, edit, diff, add-type, remove-type, update-type, add-alias, remove-alias, add-prefix, remove-prefix, add-link-type, remove-link-type, set-extractable, set-expert-routing.
Remove 18 entries from UNMIGRATED_TS_SCHEMA_PACK_VERBS.
Depends on 1-1, 1-2, 1-3 (lint rules used in mutation precheck).

1-5.label: Discovery + repair verbs (5 verbs)
1-5.notes:
Port discovery/repair modules + wire 5 CLI verbs:
- detect.ts (177 lines) -> SQL-driven heuristic clustering, derive candidate manifest from brain data.
- suggest.ts (131 lines) -> LLM-enhanced detect refinement (hermetic-by-default).
- review.ts (132 lines) -> review-candidates (disk re-derivation) + review-orphans.
- sync.ts (216 lines) -> runSyncCore (backfill pages.type by path_prefix, dry-run default, chunked UPDATE).
- candidate-audit.ts (142 lines) -> logCandidate, readRecentCandidates, computeIsoWeekName.
- redos-guard.ts (139 lines) -> PageRegexBudget, runRegexBounded (ReDoS protection for link inference).
- expert-types.ts (62 lines), extractable.ts (52 lines), enrichable.ts (51 lines), link-inference.ts (114 lines) -> type accessor helpers.
CLI verbs: detect, suggest, review-candidates, review-orphans, sync.
Remove last 5 entries from UNMIGRATED_TS_SCHEMA_PACK_VERBS (constant should be empty -> delete it + anchor test).
Depends on 1-1 through 1-4.

1-6.label: Consumer rewiring + TS deletion (resolve G4)
1-6.notes:
Delete TS schema-pack (26 files, ~4929 lines) + resolve G4 in KNOWN-GAPS.
GATE: TS schema-pack consumers must be handled first:
- operations.ts (4243 lines, 12+ dynamic imports) — heaviest consumer. If still TS at this point, either port schema-pack-consuming operations to Rust OR keep TS schema-pack as thin shim calling Rust (FFI not available in TS; instead the operations that use schema-pack must be individually ported or the schema-pack TS files kept until operations.ts is ported).
- cycle/ (3 files) — loadActivePack calls during cycle execution.
- commands/ (4 files) — eval-schema-authoring, import, sync, whoknows.
- calibration/ (1 file) — type imports only.
- artifact/ (1 file) — type imports + manifest validation.
Decision needed at this node: can we delete all 26 TS files, or must some stay until operations.ts migration? Use Phase11 ts_dep_closure method to verify.
If operations.ts still consumes schema-pack: either (a) port those operations first, or (b) keep schema-pack TS as KEEP seed + register sub-gap. Resolve G4 only when constant is empty + TS files deleted.
Update typecheck baseline (shrink by any schema-pack-related errors).
Depends on 1-1 through 1-5.
